note: Renames the ROLE_NOTIFICATIONS onboarding step and all related files, logic and events to AI_REPORTS / aiReports.
Deletes sanitize_legacy_definitions and the envelope validator; keeps only drop_legacy_dependents driven by the builder's excluded ID-to-key map, cohort tracking moves into the builder.
Changes date range resolution and stable series ids; the hand-rolled csvCell helper and manual CSV join remain, no PapaParse adoption.
Replaces hand-written extension notification, widget and editor-text interfaces with types derived from the vendor RpcExtensionUIRequest and WidgetPlacement across the PR.
Adds check_mcp_url_policy(url, team_id) in url_policy that calls is_url_allowed internally and switches all call sites to it.
Adds State::record_project_secret_key_usage(Option<String>) wrapping the if-let stamp and uses it at the flag_definitions and remote_config sites.
Renames the Outputs enum to Output throughout; the &str lifetime on Custom, route shadowing and unrealizable PerSession decision are not changed here.
Drops the malformed_leaves map, adds malformed_leaf_count to CohortParseFlags, increments it in record_dropped and iterates flags in freeze_with.
Adds products.event_definitions to the ai_observability depends_on list in tach.toml, alongside an unrelated summary date-range fix.
Replaces the manual December/month+1 branch in next_counter_reset with first-of-month plus dateutil relativedelta(months=1).
Changes the traces server usage ingestion client name from 'apm' to 'apm_traces'.
Rust handlers rename the client list to mobile-and-desktop and add Unity; the Python file drops posthog-unity from the list but keeps the mobile naming.
Adds an evaluationsApi facade (listAllEvaluations, patchEvaluation) and removes the create/update actions and as-unknown-as casts from the logic.
Replaces the hash series id with an index into sorted labels and extracts seriesLabel; the setDates listener's duplicated hourly range check is not touched in this diff.
Introduces team_distinct_id and swaps distinct ids at each site; the repeated observability block and pass-through params stay duplicated across three graphs.
Deletes LiveWidgetIndicator.tsx and renames LiveWidgetEmptyState.tsx to a shared components.tsx holding multiple exports.
Moves rollout_state_and_variant into FeatureFlagStatusChecker as a method, dropping the checker parameter and forward-reference string.
Rewrites docstrings about produce failure semantics and renames _route_refresh_to_kafka; no shared InvalidationSource alias is introduced.
Deletes posthog/dags/common/owners.py re-export and imports JobOwners directly from posthog.job_owners.
Captures the timeout handle and clears it after the race settles; the status request is still not aborted and no mounted loader is used.
